bio.text: Ami Bera, M.D., has represented Sacramento County in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2013.

He earned both his B.S. and M.D. from the University of California, Irvine, and completed an internal medicine residency at California Pacific Medical Center after graduating from medical school in 1991.
He practiced medicine in the Sacramento area for about twenty years, including as medical director of care management for Mercy Healthcare.
